name: Scarlet Monastery Graveyard: Fallen Champion, Ironspine and Azshir stay on Normal (#7288)
contract: Decision on #7288: Fallen Champion 6488, Ironspine 6489 and Azshir the Sleepless 6490 are always present in
Scarlet Monastery on Normal. Their stock SmartAI row 0 (AI init, 90% chance, Normal-only flag 514)
force-despawned them 500 ms after initialisation. Two copies of each, spawned in a Normal instance, must all
remain after the despawn window; before the fix all six survive with probability 0.1^6.
